releases.notes:
- Expanded maintained support for Minecraft 1.21, 1.21.1, 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 and 26.2.
- Fabric and NeoForge builds are available for every supported Minecraft version.
- Preserves SleepCycle's progressive sleep mechanics, healing, effects, configuration, advancements and statistics across the supported versions.

releases.notes:
New version of SleepCycle with added ModMenu support.
- Mod Menu Support
- Improved Config Documentation
- Default Tick Speed Multiplier is set to match the Day Skip Speed
- Increased Day Skip Speed to match -> 12 seconds to change from night to day
